Environment.Topology: Direct service invocation, independent EF context per ingest, disposable SQL database on shared fixture container; no HTTP/object-store payload

Workload.DerivedSources: one per concurrency lane; avoids serializing every operation on one source lock
Workload.Setup: lane-source priming followed by exactly five untimed warmups and 30 timed ingests per arm
Workload.Fixture: DeterministicGuid(600000+i), eight production-ingested source descriptors, ordinal permutation i*73%256
Workload.Backlog: N/A: direct closed-loop calls; no durable worker queue

Method.Timing: Nearest-rank percentiles. Client wall time includes context construction/disposal; transaction from TransactionStarted through TransactionCommitted; shared retention lock from successful sp_getapplock return through commit.
Method.Resources: Process-wide CPU and total managed allocations; RSS sampled every 10ms. Includes probes/sampling, excludes SQL Server. Dedicated database DMV deltas cover index leaf operations and log file bytes/size/used space.
Method.Sql: Separate untimed exact typed-command replay at each size in a rolled-back transaction with STATISTICS XML/IO. Actual plans/rows/reads and write operators are in sql-replay-{size}.json.gz. Replay CPU/reads are diagnostic, not natural concurrency CPU/reads.
Method.LockLimits: Client completion timestamps approximate server lock release; network/commit response time is included. Source-lock acquisition includes wait and round trip. No claim of deployed throughput or unchanged W3M/W4 budgets.
Method.Writes: SQL Server STATISTICS IO has no logical-write counter; leaf insert/update/delete DMV deltas and actual plan write-row counts are explicit proxies. Log physical bytes may be buffered.

DeadlockGraphs.Source: Disposable fixture server system_health ring_buffer; asynchronous/bounded event retention may omit a graph

Replay.Boundary: One untimed production command sequence; exact parameters, all writes rolled back

Handoff: Own-identity reads are counted separately from lineage validation. EF insert batches vary with lineage size. All SQL1205/51006/51007/command-timeout failures are retained, checked for atomic rollback, never retried or counted as accepted throughput. This metadata-only 5+30 workload does not replace W3M/W4 qualification.
